It feels incredibly cooling and slippery on the skin, which is ideal if your face feels tight or windburned. It doesn't "lather" at all; instead, it creates a soothing layer that you massage in. ​Performance ​Cleaning Power: It's excellent for a morning cleanse or as a second cleanse. It removes daily grime and light oils without any "squeaky clean" (aka stripped) feeling. ​Makeup Removal: While it can handle light face makeup, it struggles with waterproof mascara or heavy foundation. You'll likely want a dedicated remover or micellar water first if you're wearing a full face. ​The "No-Rinse" Factor: One of its unique features is that it can be wiped off with a cotton pad instead of rinsed with water. This is a lifesaver if you have extremely hard water at home that usually irritates your skin. ​The Highlights ​Minimalist Formula: It contains a very short list of ingredients, reducing the chance of a reaction. ​Fragrance-Free: There is no "skincare" scent, which is a huge plus for reactive skin. ​Enriched with Thermal Spring Water: This is La Roche-Pos

I like that it has a creamy, non-foaming texture that cleanses without stripping away moisture, especially when my skin feels dry or sensitive. After rinsing, my face feels soft and comfortable rather than tight, which is something I always look for in a daily cleanser. I've noticed it works well for light makeup, though I wouldn't rely on it alone for heavy or waterproof products. Sometimes it leaves a slight milky feel if I don't rinse thoroughly, but overall, I find it to be a reliable, hydrating cleanser that keeps my skin calm and balanced.

avis.titre: Perfect for double cleansing or a gentle morning cleanser!
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I don't personally prefer a face cleanser that doesn't suds up at all (which is why I'm giving this 4 stars). If you're looking for a cleanser that bubbles up, this is definitely not for you. I do however like this cleanser for double cleansing and cleansing in the morning. This cleanser removes makeup well. I have really dry skin, so using this in the mornings is nice to add some moisture. I do recommend this product if you plan on using it in a similar way!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been using this milky cleanser for about a month now and I see a huge difference and improvement with my skin especially in the winter months. My skin has been soft and glowy and I have gotten several compliments. People have seen a difference. My skin has always been dry and this definitely helps. No irritation at all. I will definitely keep using this. It is an amazing brand!!!

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. The moisturizing milky cleanser works great on my skin without drying it out. It keeps my sensitive skin hydrated while leaving behind clean skin.

avis.titre: Very hydrating. Not good for oily skin
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The product is probably great for dry and sensitive skin. My skin is combination - dry only near the mouth area, otherwise generally oily everywhere else - so it's not the best product for me. After using for a few weeks I have decided I will only use this product when removing makeup and in a double-cleansing process. There is no fragrance and the product feels very hydrating, it just does not pair well with my oily areas.

avis.titre: Doesn't leave skin feeling very clean
avis.texte: Didn't feel like a good product for me personally. I used a good amount but it felt like it just went away as I was cleansing. Didn't feel like it absorbed either. Skin still felt dirty after.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love it . Leaves my skin feeling very soft after washing it . Doesn't create any bubbles when washing your face but still works great and realli does leave you feeling moisturized

avis.titre: Not impressed and not for me
avis.texte: This didn't feel like using a soap. It felt like I was using a moisturizer to wash my face which for me- wasn't it. I don't feel like my face was clean after use.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] First time trying this product and I'm a fan! I have sensitive skin so having a soap and fragrance free option was essential. Great absorption and non-greasy feel. A great pre-mask cleanser for my Sunday morning routine.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. Honestly such a great cleanser with moisturizing properties! Has no scent which is good for sensitive skin, and has very clean ingredients. The packing is also great, and cleanser is at a great price.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a great cleanser. I have sensitive skin and it didn't irritate my skin. It lathers on nicely and my face feels fresh and clean afterwards. I would definitely recommend!

I used this wonderful product everyday since I received it! This is absolutely THE best for dry skin, which I most certainly have. It cleans really well, and effectively.. it was able to remove my makeup effortlessly, including my long lasting liquid eyeliner. It moisturizes well while leaving your face clean and fresh. There's really no noticeable scent, and this product would also be perfect for sensitive skin.

avis.titre: This is a high quality moisturizer!
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love this moisturizing cleanser! My skin is on the drier side, and I don't like using things that strip my skin making it look dull. Does cleanser gently removes everything off my face, but it still feels hydrated, and gives you that plump feeling. No skin irritation, easy to rinse off, I have no complaints. Great packaging too, so it will survive the mail!

avis.titre: Great for dry skin and the winter months!
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This milky cleanser is a great option if you have dry skin or use products that tend to dry out your skin. It has a creamy texture that lathers nicely and has little to no scent. One pump is enough to cleanse my entire face, and it feels really gentle and soothing on the skin. It doesn't leave my skin feeling tight or stripped after washing, which I love especially during the colder months. I have oily, sensitive skin that can get a bit dry in the winter and this cleanser has worked really well for me. It hasn't caused any breakouts and keeps my skin feeling hydrated and balanced.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This milky cleanser has a thick, white texture/color to it. It didn't have any kind of scent to it and was easy to lather when water was added to it. It was easy to rinse off with water as well. It left my face feeling like it had a layer of moisture on it. This lasted into the next day as well, as I could still feel like my face felt moisturized. This is a great product, especially during the fall and winter months when your skin gets dried out more easily.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this cleanser! It's so hydrating and a little goes a long way. Does a great job and cleansing without drying out my skin, especially in the winter months where I have more combination skin. Excited to see how this does in the spring and summer. My skin feels so soft

avis.titre: Hydrating, not great at fully removing makeup
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This cleanser works well to hydrate your skin once your makeup has been removed. It feels nice on the skin, but doesn't work well as a makeup remover. So, take that into consideration when choosing this as a cleanser. I also prefer to use it at night and another cleanser in the am (one that rinses away a little easier). In summary, a nice moisturizing cleanser, but expect to use something else with it to fully remove makeup.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It is a great cleanser. It doesn't have a scent which I love. It is a milky consistency cleanser that cleans my face and left it feeling great. I love that it came in a bottle with a pump. It didn't cause me to break out and actually helped my skin. I had high expectations for the brand and it lived up to my expectations so I would recommend it.

avis.titre: Gentle, hydrating, and fragrance-free, the La Roche-Posay To
avis.texte: La Roche Posay Toleriane Moisturizing Milky Facial Cleanser is a gentle reliable option for anyone with normal to dry or sensitive skin. After a few weeks of daily use, it has proven to be both effective and comforting. The first thing I noticed was the smooth, milky texture. The consistency is light weight yet creamy - not too thick and not watery. The cleanser is practically fragrance-free with little to no noticeable scent. The simple, hygienic packaging is easy to use, and considering how long it lasts, it offers great value for the price.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have very sensitive skin so I am always hesitant trying new products. At first I was nervous as this cleanser felt like it was a film on my skin, but I experienced zero breakouts. My skin feels about the same moisture level, which is dry, but this didn't dry me out any more than others. Very light scent

avis.titre: Perfect after a heavy makeup day
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've incorporated this into my skincare routine for the past 2 weeks and I love it. I like using it after a day of heavy makeup wear since it doesn't irritate my eyes either. No strong smell and feels very soothing on the face. A large amount of product as well.

avis.titre: Scent Free, Gentle, and Moisturizing Clearser
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This Toleriane Moisturizing Milky Cleanser by La Roche Posay is delicate on my face and skin. It is scent free and makes my skin feel fresh and clean without drying it out. One pump of product goes is plenty to wash your entire face and neck. The consistency of the cleanser feels like lotion when applying it to the skin. It is easy to rub in and apply to the skin thoroughly. I would definitely get it again and recommend it to friends and family.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I have combination skin but sometimes more dry and sensitive in the winter so I thought this might be nice to use on the days where my skin has been through more intense elements. I also do regularly wear heavier makeup and I like that I can use this on my eye area as well. This is very moisturizing and I almost don't feel like I need a moisturizer after. It's hard to get used to that feeling because I'm used to harsher cleansers but it's nice to give your skin a break from that. I like using this in the shower after I've taken off my makeup with make up remover as a second pass to make sure everything is off.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review I love this cleanser especially in the winter. It leaves my skin super soft hydrated and it doesn't have a strong scent. Its milky texture makes it perfect for everyday use even when the skin barrier feels compromised.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was pleasantly surprised when I opened the packing, this product looks very luxe! I love using this cleanser in the winter when my skin is dry, it really brings it back to life. Highly recommend giving this cleanser a try.
